items.title: 9.1.1 Design Thinking (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design thinking (PDF 208).

blocks.title: Design thinking
blocks.text: Design thinking masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhne ka tareeqa hai: hal par kood parne ki bajaye pehle masla gehrai se samjha jata hai. Is ke paanch qadam hain: empathize, define, ideate, prototype aur test.

items: Empathize: users ki jagah khud ko rakhein; students se school bags ki pasand aur na-pasand poochein.
Define: masla wazeh likhein: students ko halka, mazboot, kushada aur uthane mein aaramdeh bag chahiye.
Ideate: kamil hone ki fikr ke baghair bohat se khayalat sochein, jaise izafi padding ya khane.
Prototype: jaldi saada namoona banayein, jaise gatte, kapre ya kaghaz ka model.
Test: students ko istemal karwa ke raye lein, aur masla hal hone tak behtar karein.

blocks.alt: Baen: chakkar mein paanch dabbe, Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype aur Test, har ek school bag ki misal ke saath, aur Test se wapas Empathize tak surkh teer. Daen: business plan ke hisson ke saat dabbe chhote notes ke saath. Neeche: juice ki dukaan ki misal se pitch ke paanch qadam, masla, hal, munfarid nukta, sameen aur sawalat.
blocks.caption: Design thinking, business plan aur pitch (topics 9.1 se 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Design thinking users se hamdardi se shuru hoti hai, jaise students se un ke bags ke baare mein poochna, phir masla tay karti hai (halka, mazboot, kushada bag), hal sochti hai (padding, jebein), jaldi namoona banati hai (gatte ka model) aur users se aazmati hai; un ka feedback wapas ja kar design behtar karta hai. Business plan mein executive summary, business description, market analysis, organization aur management, products ya services, marketing aur sales, aur financial plan hote hain. Pitch masla, hal, munfarid baat aur kis ke liye hai batati aur sawalat ki tayyari karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Design thinking ka usool kaunsa hai (MCQ 2)? Is mein kaunsi takneek aam hai (MCQ 4)? Is ki bunyadi tawajjo kya hai (short question 2)?
blocks.explanation: (b) insan markooz tareeqa; (b) brainstorming. Is ki bunyadi tawajjo product istemal karne wale log hain: design se pehle un ki zarooratein gehrai se samajhna, phir un ke saath aazmana aur behtar karna.

items: Design thinking: empathize, define, ideate, prototype, test, aur dohrao.
